name: PowerChain
description: PowerChain (PWRC) is the native fixed-supply Token-2022 utility token of the PowerChain ecosystem. PWRC is designed for digital payments, settlement, cross-chain services, application utilities, protocol operations, and renewable-energy-related digital infrastructure. The token is built around transparent fixed-supply policy, deterministic transaction handling, and wallet-owned execution. PWRC does not represent equity, debt, dividends, ownership of energy assets, carbon credits, or a claim on company revenue.

wrappedDescription: Wrapped PowerChain (wPWRC) is the Sui representation of canonical PWRC, designed for 1:1 base-unit cross-chain accounting and access to PowerChain utility use cases, including payments, applications, protocol operations, and renewable-energy-related digital infrastructure.
disclaimer: PWRC is a utility token and does not represent equity, debt, dividends, ownership of renewable-energy assets, carbon credits, or a claim on company revenue.
